name: account_research
instructions: Evaluate target account technical fit, assign an ICP fit score from 0 to 100 based on infrastructure bottlenecks or data scale, identify key technical gaps, and cite verbatim evidence.

score.description: ICP fit: 85-100 active explicit initiative quoted verbatim, 70-84 confirmed stack plus senior infra hiring, 50-69 firmographic fit only, 0-49 incompatible stack or wrong model.

fit_tier.description: Score band: tier_1 85-100, tier_2 70-84, tier_3 50-69, unfit below 50. Must equal the score band.

identified_gap.description: The verified technical initiative or bottleneck, named exactly as the source names it.

reasoning.description: Short explanation grounded in the cited quotes, naming the evidence behind score and gap.
